name: kiro
description: Claude plans, Kiro implements and reviews — a cost-savings delegation plugin. Claude designs specs and verifies results while Kiro CLI (subscription credits) writes the code inside an isolated worktree and can optionally review diffs before commit.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate implementation to Kiro CLI to save tokens.
interface.longDescription: Plan with Codex, hand off implementation tasks to Kiro CLI (flat-rate subscription credits) inside an isolated git worktree, verify with tests. Falls back to the host writing the code when Kiro's fix-loop is exhausted. (The Kiro-run pre-commit review and /kiro:* commands are Claude Code-only — this Codex manifest exposes the implementation-delegation skill only.)
